name: personal-mcp-for-garmin
description: Read-only access to your own Garmin Connect data (sleep, HRV, Body Battery, workouts) via Garmin's official Personal API. Bring your own key.
long_description: Unofficial; not affiliated with or endorsed by Garmin. Runs on your computer and talks only to Garmin's Personal API using your own Personal API key, which stays in your operating system's secure storage. All tools are read-only and every result is attributed to Garmin. Your key is for your own use only under Garmin's Personal API terms; never share it. Create a key at https://connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken

api_key.title: Garmin Personal API key
api_key.description: Create it at connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken (shown only once). For your own use only; never share it.

region.title: Account region
region.description: global for most accounts; cn for China-region (garmin.cn) accounts.

tools.name: daily_summary
tools.description: Daily overview: steps, distance, calories, resting heart rate, stress, Body Battery, intensity minutes, floors. Give only start for one day, or start+end for a daily list.

tools.name: sleep
tools.description: Sleep: duration, deep/light/REM/awake stages, sleep score and feedback. The date is the day you woke up. Only start: detailed single night; start+end: summaries for the range.

tools.name: heart_rate
tools.description: One day of heart rate: resting, max, min and the all-day time series.

tools.name: hrv
tools.description: HRV: overnight average, baseline range and status. Only start: single-day detail; start+end: daily summaries.

tools.name: body_battery
tools.description: Daily Body Battery reports (charged, drained, highs and lows).

tools.name: stress
tools.description: Daily stress statistics for a date range.

tools.name: steps
tools.description: Daily steps, distance and step goal for a date range.

tools.name: hydration
tools.description: Daily hydration logs for a date range.

tools.name: spo2_acclimation
tools.description: Blood oxygen (SpO2) and altitude acclimation for one day.

tools.name: weight
tools.description: Weight and body composition entries for a date range.

tools.name: weight_goal
tools.description: Weight goals in effect during a date range.

tools.name: vo2max
tools.description: Daily VO2 max (MaxMET) values. Optional sport filter, e.g. ["RUNNING"] or ["CYCLING"]. Readings are only recorded on some days, so use a wide date range.

tools.name: fitness_age
tools.description: Fitness age and the factors behind it.

tools.name: heart_rate_zones
tools.description: The user's configured heart rate zones.

tools.name: nutrition
tools.description: Food log and nutrition goals for one day.

tools.name: menstrual_cycle
tools.description: Menstrual cycle summary; detailed=True returns the detailed day view.

tools.name: user_settings
tools.description: User settings: units, height, weight, birth date, sleep schedule, etc.

tools.name: activities
tools.description: Search activities, newest first. activity_type e.g. running, cycling, swimming (see activity_types). compact=True returns the common fields, including pace, heart rate zone seconds, cadence, stride and training effect; compact=False returns every field (including the owner's name and GPS start/end points). Use activity_detail for laps.

tools.name: activity_detail
tools.description: Full summary of one activity: splits, heart rate, pace, training effect.

tools.name: activity_workouts
tools.description: Workouts linked to one activity.

tools.name: activity_summary_range
tools.description: Wellness activity records (e.g. breathwork) in a date range. This is NOT a workout summary; use activities for runs, rides and other workouts.

tools.name: activity_types
tools.description: All supported activity types (the typeKey works as activities' activity_type).

tools.name: download_activity_file
tools.description: Download one activity's original file (FIT, usually zipped) to the local Downloads/garmin folder and return its path. Writes a local file only; nothing changes in Garmin Connect.
